# PR Rework — gh-2044 fragile-band escalation (leg 3: CI red on head `3448229c`)

## Issues/Notes

Validation CI on the previously pushed head went red on 5 checks (run 41468813223).
`ci_violations.json` carries no owned table (`owned: 0, unknown: 8` — all reds with
`path: null`), so each red was triaged individually and owned-by-evidence:

| CI check | verdict | disposition |
|---|---|---|
| Flutter app tests shard 0/2 (`agent_service_test.dart:2921` — over-window guard, `Expected: 'continued' / Actual: ''`) | **fixed** | root cause is this PR's shared whole-world decline (see Approach); fixed in the engine + pinned by UT-ESC-13 |
| Flutter app tests shard 1/2 (`agent_service_compaction_it_test.dart:324` — IT-3 over-window relief, same signature) | **fixed** | same root cause, same fix; both app suites now fully green locally |
| CRAP + duplication (`guards` job, exit 2 — `Max CRAP: 20.21 > 12.00` on `StructuredCompactor._runCheckpointEscalationPass`, `lib/src/compaction/structured/engine.dart:747`) | **fixed** | complexity 20 → 12 and coverage-driven CRAP 12.07 → ≤ 12.00 by extracting cohesive helpers (`_runEscalationFold`, `_escalationReceipt`, `_hideableRemainingOf`, `_appendEscalationCheckpoint`, `_escalationCounts`, `_wholeWorldDeclines`); the local crap4dart gate (0.15.0, pinned range) exits 0 |
| Quality gate (aggregate — red because `guards` + `flutter-tests` + `build-android` are red) | **fixed** | follows the two fixes above; the aggregate clears once its legs are green |
| Build Android APK (debug) | **disputed: infra, not this diff** — the leg's own log names it: `NDK 28.2.13676358 install failed after 3 attempts — gh-1655 red'd the leg on a single truncated archive` (a documented download-corruption flake; no repository file involved; it is a PLATFORM leg — it reddens the aggregate but never gates the Dart publish, #1368) | the fresh validation on the new head re-attempts the NDK download |

No open review threads exist on this PR (GraphQL census: 4 total, **0 unresolved** —
verified again from the refreshed `pr_discussions_raw.json` this leg), so this leg
needs no thread replies; `outputs/review_replies.json` is `{ "replies": [] }`.
The bot comments arming this rework (red 1/3, red 2/3 on `3448229c`) are the
CI-failure rework mandate, addressed above.

## Approach

1. **Reproduce the app reds locally first** (TDD RED): both failing app tests
   reproduce with `flutter test` on this head — and, decisively, also reproduce on
   the PR's base head `ec08acbada`, while the same tests **pass on `origin/main`**.
   So the regression belongs to the PR's compaction change, not to my previous leg's
   28-line `compactSession` guard.
2. **Isolate the divergence.** A core-level replica of the app fixture (user ask +
   carrier + a 34000-char tool result over an 8192 window at the app's hosted
   settings `reserve 2048 / keep 4096`) behaves identically on main and on the PR
   head at the factory level — the difference only appears with the app's exact
   inputs. Instrumenting the app's own hooks showed the split:
   - on **main**: ONE `structured·ckpt` pass folds the whole world
     (`8525 → 85` tokens) — the huge tool result's ledger tokens (~850) fit
     `keepRecentTokens` (4096), the keep-recent walk never cuts, `cut ==
     foldable.length`, and main's pick folds it anyway → the over-window turn
     continues (AC4 / #387-analogue);
   - on the **PR head**: the same regime hits the whole-world decline this PR added
     to `_pickCheckpointRange` → the pick returns `null` → no structured pass → the
     classic residual engine appends a contentless record (+29 tokens) and reports
     hollow success → the app's relief gate (`afterTokens < beforeTokens`) fails →
     the turn dies with `''`.
   The escalation's decline is correct (gh-2044 semantic 5 — it only runs UNDER the
   trigger, so folding the live world there is pure destruction; UT-ESC-12 pins
   that). The bug is that the decline also gated the checkpoint **ladder**, whose
   passes run only OVER the trigger — there the fold IS the relief.
3. **Fix (GREEN)**: `_pickCheckpointRange` gains a `wholeWorldDeclines` parameter —
   the ladder passes `false` (relief required), the escalation passes `true`
   (semantic 5 unchanged). The decline body moved into `_wholeWorldDeclines`.
4. **CRAP ratchet**: the escalation pass had complexity 20 (CRAP 20.21). Extracted
   the fold work into `_runEscalationFold` (carrying the exact semantics:
   `TimeoutException` rethrow per #515, the total-budget latch per gh-2044
   semantic 7, cancel-outranks-error per #1085, append failure-safety), the receipt
   construction into `_escalationReceipt`, and the covered/visible counting into
   `_escalationCounts`. Complexity is now 12 with the same tests; the local
   crap4dart gate passes.
5. CHANGELOG `## Unreleased` gh-2044 entry extended with the third-red paragraph.

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/compaction/structured/engine.dart` — escalation-only whole-world
  decline (`_pickCheckpointRange({wholeWorldDeclines})`, `_wholeWorldDeclines`);
  escalation-pass decomposition for the CRAP ratchet (`_runEscalationFold`,
  `_escalationReceipt`, `_hideableRemainingOf`, `_appendEscalationCheckpoint`,
  `_escalationCounts`). No behavior change beyond the ladder relief.
- `test/compaction/structured_escalation_test.dart` — new `UT-ESC-13` group: the
  tool-result-heavy whole-world fixture through `AutoCompactorFactory` (RED before
  the fix, GREEN after), pinning: a shrinking structured pass, no classic
  fall-through pass, no contentless `CompactionRecord`, and a rebuilt projection
  smaller than the original request.
- `flutter_app/lib/services/agent_service_compaction.dart` — removes debug prints
  that the WIP auto-save commits had captured mid-investigation (net: file restored
  to its committed pre-debug state).
- `CHANGELOG.md` — gh-2044 entry extended.
- `outputs/response.md`, `outputs/review_replies.json` — this summary; empty
  replies (0 open threads).

## Test Coverage

- **RED first**: UT-ESC-13 failed exactly as CI did (no shrinking pass; hollow

- `dart test test/compaction/` → **444 passed** (includes UT-ESC-12's escalation

- `dart test test/agent/` → **592 passed**; compaction+agent coverage run

  complexity 12 with the ratchet green; `_pickCheckpointRange` 12.00 at 100% cov.
- `flutter test test/agent_service_compaction_it_test.dart` → **6 passed**;

  test/compaction/structured_escalation_test.dart`) still exits 0.
- Full core-equivalent run on the frozen tree:
